data.Q: After the fig tree replies, whom do the trees invite to rule?
data.A: They invite the vine to be their king.
data.wrong_answer: They invite the fig tree to be their king.

data.Q: What do the trees ask the vine to do?
data.A: The trees ask the vine to be king over them.
data.wrong_answer: The trees ask the vine to give up its fruit.

data.Q: Over whom would the fig tree rule if it left its fruit?
For whose sake do the trees ask the vine to be king?
